model: Ultralytics YOLOv8n COCO, existing personal EdgeVisionRT artifact

provenance.weight_source: existing yolov8n.pt; original download log not retained
provenance.license: AGPL-3.0 (model metadata); weights and engine are not redistributed
provenance.export_reproduction: metadata audited; original export environment is not independently reconstructed

preprocess.rounding: Python round to nearest even; symmetric padding round(d/2 - 0.1), round(d/2 + 0.1)
preprocess.coordinate_inverse: subtract actual left/top integer padding, divide by original min(640/w,640/h), clip to original image bounds

output.name: output0
output.layout: 4 cxcywh pixel channels then 80 independent class probability channels; no objectness

postprocess.stable_tie_break: score descending, then anchor index, then class index
postprocess.coco_category_mapping: sorted 80 COCO category IDs, not class_index+1

first_evaluation_gates.reference: ONNX Runtime 1.20.1 CPUExecutionProvider, exact same frozen normalized inputs
first_evaluation_gates.AP_definition: COCOeval bbox AP@[.50:.05:.95], area=all, maxDets=100, same selected image IDs; subset metric only
first_evaluation_gates.raw_output_error: record absolute/RMS/percentile errors separately for coordinates and scores; not a universal elementwise relative tolerance near zero
first_evaluation_gates.threshold_policy: retain first failures and investigate; do not relax gates after observing results

target.foundation: personal subclass of repaired upstream tensorNet; no independent TRT loader
